Traupman 262

programma, programmatis n.

noun, third declension

a program

Plural programmata, genitive plural programmatum; the third-declension stem has short a.

Examples

  • «Programmata,» inquit, «in computātrulō compōnō …»

    “I write programs,” he said, “on the laptop …”Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

  • corpus programmatum

    a collection or body of programscomposed

Other words

  • programmō, programmāre, programmāvī, programmātum — to program

    verb, first conjugation · modern · M-O, Silva, citing Vox Latina

  • programma compōnere — write a program

    also used · modern · Traupman 262

See also programming, programmer, software, computer.
